description: Supplies natural gas, electricity, public grid; companies, SIC 2008, region is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. This table shows figures on the supply of electricity and natural gas through the public grid to companies including the supply to industrial grids. In-house electricity production for private use only is not included in these figures. Figures are broken down by sector of industry and region. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
